headline: Original assembly classification raises PAL v2.00's finished total
summary: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 matched-code report rose from 98.38% to 98.40%, with 5,080 of 5,124 entries reported finished. Pull request #112 classifies two level routines as original handwritten assembly, leaving their compiled game image unchanged. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. This increase recognises finished original-source work rather than adding new C.
